result.title: vFedProtoQNAS: Prototype-Guided Personalized Quantum Neural Architecture Search for Virtual Federated Learning
result.summary: Quantum federated learning (QFL) has emerged as a promising approach for collaboratively training compact quantum neural networks (QNNs) over distributed private data on resource-constrained devices. However, differences in device capabilities make a single shared QNN architecture unsuitable for all clients. While personalized quantum neural architecture search (QNAS) allows each client to select a device-specific QNN, averaging parameters across structurally different QNN architectures mixes semantically inconsistent circuit operations. To address this, prototype-guided personalized QNAS for virtual FL (vFedProtoQNAS) is proposed, where model parameters are never aggregated across clients and federated collaboration is achieved through class-wise prototype sharing. Each client independently searches and trains a client-specific QNN, computes class-wise local prototypes from latent representations, and refines them using global prototypes from the server as federated semantic anchors. Experiments demonstrate that vFedProtoQNAS improves accuracy by 3.70\% over FedAvg and enhances class-consistent representation alignment.

AI.brief_summary: 提出原型引导的个性化量子神经架构搜索方法，用于虚拟联邦学习：各客户端独立搜索并训练量子网络，只通过类级原型与服务器共享语义，而不聚合同构参数。
AI.relevance_reason: 研究焦点是联邦量子架构搜索与异构参数聚合问题，虽涉及隐表示原型对齐，但无视觉/多模态推理、latent 推理状态生成或证据筛选的联系，缺乏可借鉴的具体线索。
